new_sources.summary: In the second presentation of this Apologetics Conference , we delve into a comparison of three major time periods: (1) the age of authority, (2) the age of reason, and (3) the age of authenticity. We look at how people practiced their faith in each as well as what criticisms apologists answered. For our post-modern time, I recommend the strategy of discussing a social issue, showing how our society is failing to address it, and how Christianity can offer a solution. Last of all we try out this strategy on a number of controversial issues, including gun violence, sexual harassment, and technology use. new_sources.summary: Artificial intelligence presses the deeper question of what it means to be human. Camden Bucey speaks with ethicist Jason Thacker about human dignity, the image of God, embodied life, AI companionship, transhumanism, and Christian hope. They explain why machines remain tools rather than persons and why Scripture equips the church to engage emerging technology without naïveté or fear.
new_sources.title: Human Dignity in the Age of AI
